governance.fixed_u_test_tighten_r05: Set true for the specified tightened repeat; bind the actual active R05 targets and streak in the lock.

A4_2_M2_2.target: dE_Hub/dU at fixed converged P(U0), from evaluate_hubbard_energy at U0 plus/minus small epsilon; bind epsilon sequence, units, and exact captured P before response.

J_scan.target: dE_Hub/dJ at fixed captured P; bind finite-difference stencil and units before response.

per_component_error_budget.finite_difference_truncation: Richardson estimate from the preregistered delta series; lock stencil and estimator before outcomes.
per_component_error_budget.SCF_scatter: One repeat at each delta with preregistered tightened threshold; lock aggregation before outcomes.
per_component_error_budget.smooth_systematic: N_W at the matching perturbation scale; this transfer is not authorized until its separate preregistration and required user approval.

predictions.c: Expected miss approximately dt/dU; recompute from accepted captured arrays, then preregister numeric value and allowance before response.
predictions.b: Expected pass within the preregistered total error floor N; preregister numeric interval before response.
predictions.a: Measure and report; no directional prediction.

decision.b_pass_and_c_fail_as_predicted: Adopt the A4.2 result for the KS gate evaluation; physical routing remains forbidden until the M2 gate decision.
decision.b_fail: STOP and report, regardless of a.

A4_3_M2_3.comparison: For every state, compare spectral and local modes using identical definitions, same physical recipe, converged histories, and bound mode-specific inputs.

observable_definitions_to_freeze.sphere_spin_moment: Use one documented sphere-integrated definition for both modes; record units and source output.
observable_definitions_to_freeze.d_q0_per_spin: Record integrated d charge per spin from the accepted endpoint.
observable_definitions_to_freeze.P_eigenvalue_bounds: Hermitian P eigenvalue min/max per spin, with matrix source/hash.
observable_definitions_to_freeze.d_center_exchange_splitting: Record spin-resolved d-center definition, energy units, and subtraction order.
observable_definitions_to_freeze.E_F: Record Fermi level in Ry and its source output.
observable_definitions_to_freeze.E_int_E_DC_E_Hub_t: Record per-site and total quantities, with the same convention in both modes.
observable_definitions_to_freeze.candidates_F_TS: Record all a/b/c energy candidates, T*S, and F=E-T*S in Ry/cell; retain candidate formula lineage.
observable_definitions_to_freeze.converged_residuals: Record charge, R05 density/potential residual histories, streak, and stopping thresholds.

moment_change_resolution.question: Determine whether the apparent 2.356 to 2.511 μB change between spectral and local U=2 states is reproducible under identical definitions.
